original_text: After reset the FIFO is empty and not full, with out_valid = 0 and in_ready = 1.
normalized_semantics: At the first rising edge after rst is deasserted (rst held across >= 1 rising edge): empty=1, full=0, out_valid=0, in_ready=1.

legal_environment.text: rst is held high across at least one rising edge of clk before use

original_text: in_ready == !full and out_valid == !empty at all times after reset.
normalized_semantics: For every cycle after reset: in_ready equals the negation of full, and out_valid equals the negation of empty.

legal_environment.text: rst is held high across at least one rising edge of clk before use

original_text: Accepted words are popped in exactly the order they were accepted.
normalized_semantics: The sequence of out_data values at pop handshakes equals the sequence of in_data values at push handshakes.

original_text: full holds iff occupancy equals DEPTH; empty holds iff occupancy is 0.
normalized_semantics: Occupancy = accepted pushes - accepted pops since reset; full <-> occupancy == DEPTH; empty <-> occupancy == 0.

original_text: A push attempted while full is rejected and has no effect of its own (F3); an independently accepted pop in the same cycle still performs its normal state transition.
normalized_semantics: When full, in_ready = 0, so no push is accepted, even if a pop occurs in the same cycle (F3). The rejected push contributes nothing; a same-cycle accepted pop still updates occupancy and order as usual.

original_text: A pop attempted while empty is rejected and has no effect of its own; an independently accepted push in the same cycle still performs its normal state transition.
normalized_semantics: When empty, out_valid = 0, so out_ready accepts no pop. The rejected pop contributes nothing; a same-cycle accepted push still updates occupancy and contents as usual.

original_text: A simultaneous push and pop, when neither full nor empty, keeps occupancy and order.
normalized_semantics: In a cycle with both handshakes and 0 < occupancy < DEPTH, occupancy is unchanged and FIFO order is preserved. Rule: DEPTH >= 2; encoded over the finite seed matrix as DEPTH in {2,3,4,8}.

original_text: While out_valid && !out_ready, out_data holds its value.
normalized_semantics: If out_valid = 1 and out_ready = 0 in a cycle, out_data in the next cycle equals out_data in this cycle.

original_text: No fall-through: a push into an empty FIFO becomes visible on the next cycle.
normalized_semantics: If the FIFO is empty in a cycle with a push, out_valid stays 0 in that cycle and becomes 1 in the next cycle with that word on out_data.
